## About
Sam's Auto Parts is a junkyard serving the Fridley, MN area with quality used parts.
Need a part? Call us and ask. We'll tell you what we have.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used auto parts for drivers and repair shops in the Fridley area.

## FAQ
Q: Can I call to check if you have my part?
A: Yes. Call and ask. One customer called to see if we had a part, and we went out and checked whether it was in stock.
